dialect: PostgreSQL (typedpg_pg_query::parse, libpg_query's default top-level grammar mode)
parser_family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser); same family as the C libpg_query path, Rust pg_query, Go pg_query_go, Python pglast and JavaScript libpg-query. typedpg_pg_query vendors its own libpg_query copy (PostgreSQL 18.6 grammar) with build-time patches, and its own generated protobuf, node-walk and equality code
api: typedpg_pg_query::parse(local UTF-8 text) -> ParseResult; the harness reads the protobuf SelectStmt (target_list, where_clause, group_clause, sort_clause) and InsertStmt (relation, cols, VALUES lists) and walks each statement with the crate's own NodeEnum::nodes() breadth-first walk for RangeVar, FuncCall, JoinExpr and A_Const nodes
coverage: Rust LLVM source coverage of the typedpg_pg_query 0.7.3 binding (parse, stack growth, protobuf decode and node walk) and its csrc/catalog.c, plus clang 23.1.3 LLVM source coverage of the vendored libpg_query C compiled by its build script, in one profile; files the crate patches at build time are compiled from OUT_DIR copies, kept in the image as patched-libpg_query/. libFuzzer sanitizer counters in the Rust crates and the C objects
scope: One SQL statement from local UTF-8 text with the default PostgreSQL grammar; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. Integer constants are converted to decimal text, which equals the source text for these controls. The #line directives of the bison/flex outputs gram.c and scan.c are removed before the build so coverage maps to the pinned C files. PL/pgSQL, catalog, type-name, scan and deparse APIs are untested.
underlying_package: libpg_query (vendored in the typedpg_pg_query crate: PostgreSQL 18.6 parser, scanner and protobuf output, with the crate's build-time patches)
